title: Volume
summary: Volume shows how much traded in each candle. Compare each bar with its recent average to see whether a move had more or less participation than usual.
unreliableWhen: Heavy volume does not show direction or what happens next. Volume jumps at opens, closes and news. On forex, platforms show tick volume from one broker, not the whole market.
goodExample: Noting that a breakout candle traded about 2.5 times the 20-candle average, and still treating the breakout as unproven.
badExample: Calling a breakout "confirmed" because volume was high, or reading forex tick volume as total market trading.

chart.lookFor: Find the breakout candle and compare its volume bar with the 10 bars before it. Then open False breakout: did the failed move also have a tall bar?
